description.value: 10 Acres At The Pier is a west coast seafood and farm-to-table restaurant located inside the Pier Hotel on Sidney's waterfront, operated by the 10 Acres Farm & Restaurants group. The kitchen draws on ingredients grown at the group's own 10-acre farm, including heritage-breed livestock, orchard fruit, and heirloom vegetables, making for a menu that changes with the seasons. A cyclist finishing the Saanich Peninsula loop would find a full sit-down lunch and dinner service steps from the waterfront, with a sushi bar, fresh oysters, and a weekend brunch option as well.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: stands (5 spaces) at 34m; rack (8 spaces) at 40m; rack (8 spaces, covered) at 70m. Total: 21 spaces.
